$comment: Generated from yp_video/web/train_requests.py via make_train_schemas.py — do not edit by hand.
description:
One SPOT training run: a recipe (which heads) plus how to train it.

Fields outside the chosen recipe's ``fields`` (contract ``RECIPES``) are
accepted and ignored — the form sends every field with its default — so
a rally run carries ``sample_fps`` harmlessly and an action run
``extract_fps``.

recipe.description: Which task heads share the one checkpoint.
recipe.title: Recipe

init_checkpoint.description: Empty trains from scratch; a package carrying every head of this recipe fine-tunes from it (extra heads are skipped on load).
init_checkpoint.title: Init Checkpoint

camera_view.description: Train on all views together or restrict to one camera view.
camera_view.title: Camera View

validation.description: ratio holds out a seeded val_ratio of the videos; manual validates on validation_videos; none validates on the training set (a final fit, no model selection).
validation.title: Validation

validation_videos.description: manual: the videos (stems) held out as the validation set.
validation_videos.title: Validation Videos

val_ratio.description: ratio: fraction of videos held out as the validation split.
val_ratio.title: Val Ratio

split_seed.description: Seed for the train/val video shuffle — keep it fixed to compare runs.
split_seed.title: Split Seed

dataset_scope.description: association_action: joint_only trains on videos with both action and association labels; partial_labels also uses action-only videos (their actor head sees no supervision).
dataset_scope.title: Dataset Scope

include_predictions.description: Action recipes: also train on videos that only have SPOT pre-annotations (no human labels). Needs manual validation so pseudo-labeled videos never validate, and partial_labels scope.
include_predictions.title: Include Predictions

extract_fps.description: Rally recipes: frame-extraction rate, also the model's sample_fps. Rally on/off is a slow signal — 2 fps gives clip_len=64 a 32 s window and keeps the whole library's frame cache around 30 GB.
extract_fps.title: Extract Fps

video_limit.description: Rally recipes: 0 = every annotated video. A positive limit takes a seeded-shuffle subset (stable across runs) so a quick experiment doesn't extract hundreds of hours of frames first.
video_limit.title: Video Limit

sample_fps.description: Action recipes: per-video frame stride targeting this sampling rate. 0 = every frame.
sample_fps.title: Sample Fps

acc_grad_iter.description: Action recipes: split each optimizer step into N micro-batches (batch_size must divide evenly).
acc_grad_iter.title: Acc Grad Iter

audio_backend.description: Action recipes: logmel adds late-fusion audio (precomputed before training); none trains a pure-visual model. Must match at inference. Rally recipes are always visual-only.
audio_backend.title: Audio Backend

temporal_arch.description: Temporal head over the frame features.
temporal_arch.title: Temporal Arch

criterion.description: Which epoch counts as best: top validation mAP or lowest loss.
criterion.title: Criterion

start_val_epoch.description: Skip validation before this epoch to save time early in a long run.
start_val_epoch.title: Start Val Epoch

epoch_num_frames.description: Frames sampled per epoch; empty uses the trainer's default budget.
epoch_num_frames.title: Epoch Num Frames

stop_vllm.description: Stop the vLLM server first to free its GPU memory for training.
stop_vllm.title: Stop Vllm

title: FusionTrainRequest
